label: Topcoder
terms_note: Public challenge list and detail (anonymous) from the Challenge V6 API swagger. Registration and submission go through separate member APIs that need a Topcoder JWT.

discovery.auth: none for public challenges (JWT/M2M for member and admin endpoints)

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit in the swagger. Two requests per second.

discover.note: GET /v6/challenges: `search` matches name, description and tags; `status` open→Active, completed→Completed (upcoming is not a public status and is rejected); without `status` all public challenges are listed. Page size up to 100 (`perPage`). The response is a bare array; the total is only in the X-Total header, so `total` is null. Prizes (prizeSets, overview.totalPrizes, numbers), phases, numOfRegistrants and numOfSubmissions stay in `raw`.

get_competition.note: GET /v6/challenges/{challengeId} (UUID). `description` is markdown; prizeSets, phases, terms and skills stay in `raw`.

standings.note: The challenge's `winners` array (placement, handle, userId) from GET /v6/challenges/{challengeId}; empty until the challenge completes. There is no public live leaderboard; `page`/`limit` do not apply.

not_offered.me: No credentials ('auth: none'); member endpoints need a Topcoder JWT from the Auth0 login, not an API key.
not_offered.my_entries: Submissions live in the separate submission API behind a member JWT; the Challenge V6 swagger has no per-member listing.
not_offered.enter: Registration is a resource creation in the separate Resources API behind a member JWT; not in the Challenge V6 swagger.
not_offered.submit: Submissions are multipart file uploads to the separate submission API (member JWT); binary uploads are out of scope.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
